title: Small eval doc fixes left by task 028
item: List judge-verifier-brief.md in the eval/agent-spec/README.md Files table, make commands/trial.md step 0 stop pointing forward to 'the kind of step 1', and shorten or move the long grading.json note that now prints under every grade table
motivation: Minor points from the task 028 review: the README omits a file the retired full kind still uses, trial.md step 0 reads backwards, and grade.py prints the whole notes field under every table.
notes: The seeded-demo point from the same review is task 040.
done_means: The README Files table lists judge-verifier-brief.md; trial.md step 0 names the kind without referring to a later step; a plain grade's output no longer carries the long grading.json note.
draft_note: Drafted by the manager on 2026-11-15 from the task 028 review. Priority left for the owner. The note change touches eval/agent-spec/grading.json, which is protected, so may_edit needs it.
